Kill [[Rand Stormweaver]] and accompanying foes.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in [[Slavers' Exile]].
* *BONUS* Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Dwarf reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[The Last Hierophant#Justiciar Thommis' level|Justiciar Thommis' level]]. Both Rand Stormweaver and the small group directly around him must be killed.

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
;Zaishen Bounty
: ''"Kill Rand Stormweaver in Slavers' Exile."''
